svg.title: Publishing route: inspect, preview, confirm gate, publish, verify, with a resume branch
svg.desc: A git branch line. On your machine: inspect (accounts, owners, inspect) and preview. A gate marks --confirm-target owner/repo; nothing crosses it without confirmation. On GitHub: publish creates the target branch, verify reads the repository and SHA back. If a publish is interrupted, a branch drops to resume against the same confirmed target and merges back into verify.
